details: US and Iranian officials have reportedly made progress in peace talks, agreeing to a 60-day roadmap towards a final deal to end their conflict. This development has led to a nearly 2% drop in Brent crude prices, settling under $79 a barrel, and easing broader geopolitical tensions despite earlier threats from President Trump and a temporary closure of the Strait of Hormuz.
title: US-Iran Peace Talks Progress, Oil Prices Drop

details: European Central Bank (ECB) policymaker José Luis Escrivá highlighted the need to monitor "second-round effects on wages" as inflationary pressures in the Eurozone have accelerated. These pressures are primarily driven by persistent higher energy prices amidst ongoing Middle East conflicts.
title: ECB Official Warns of Wage-Driven Inflation Risks

details: The Federal Reserve's recent Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting indicated a hawkish shift in policy. The median projected interest rate for 2026 was revised upwards, and the 2026 core Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) inflation projection was boosted to 3.3%. This suggests a likelihood of sustained higher interest rates, with market probabilities indicating a slightly above 51% chance of a rate hike by September.
title: US Federal Reserve's Hawkish Stance on Inflation and Rates

details: The European Union has confirmed new Anti-Money Laundering (AML) rules set to take effect by July 2027. These regulations will prohibit anonymous crypto accounts and privacy-focused cryptocurrencies such as Monero and Zcash. This will likely necessitate delisting these coins from exchanges and impose stricter Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements, impacting liquidity and user privacy within the EU crypto market.
title: EU to Ban Anonymous Crypto Accounts and Privacy Coins by 2027

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) is actively engaged in discussions regarding stablecoins and asset tokenization, focusing on their implications for monetary sovereignty, financial stability, and the development of clear regulatory frameworks. This dialogue signals a growing recognition of digital assets' role in finance and the need for robust oversight.
title: IMF Discusses Stablecoin and Asset Tokenization Frameworks

details: US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have experienced their largest rolling 30-day net outflow on record, totaling $6.35 billion, indicating continued caution among institutional investors. Conversely, a Japanese corporate pension fund is reportedly planning its first allocation of assets to cryptocurrency, signaling a gradual, yet significant, integration of digital assets into traditional institutional portfolios.
title: Bitcoin ETF Outflows Continue Amidst Japanese Pension Fund Interest
